resolvedDuringVerification.issue: Service-worker update test reopened a tab immediately after closing old clients, racing worker hand-over (old cache retained or navigation stalled); first full run 181/182, isolated 1/3.
resolvedDuringVerification.resolution: Test now waits, with zero tabs open, for the new worker to report activated with exactly one cache before reopening. Worker source unchanged.

limitations: IndexedDB is plaintext best-effort storage; private windows, clearing site data or eviction can erase it; encrypted ERPWEB01 export is the recovery path.
Supported modes: current Windows Chrome/Edge/Firefox over HTTPS or loopback; Safari, mobile and non-Windows browsers are not verified.
An update activates only after every old tab closes; reopening immediately can still be served by the previous worker until hand-over completes.
Offline grants are at most 24 hours and do not defeat a malicious OS clock or provide instant disconnected revocation.
Accepted native advisory GHSA-qwgh-2vcv-g2f7 remains open for Phase 9.
No public hosting, TLS deployment, large-dataset performance, human screen-reader trial or signed installer was performed.

reviews.accounting: Browser posting uses the shared AccountingService and ClientBookStore CAS adapter used by desktop; exact postings, duplicates, reversals, immutability, period range and company isolation pass in three browsers; cloud reconciliation with native desktop passes.
reviews.security: Fixed-origin proxy, memory-only bearer, signed Ed25519 grants, public-only Cache Storage (no company content), account-change and delayed-login handling pass. One native advisory accepted/deferred by owner.
reviews.storage: Strict IndexedDB transactions, v1->v2 upgrade, blocked/newer schema, quota abort, renderer crash, site-data loss and private-context closure produce explicit outcomes.
reviews.reference: No new Tally observation was needed; browser behavior is independently designed, not a claimed Tally observation.
